_about: The registry the release gate (tools/release_gate.py) reads: every known item that a vendor's app or a user report shows and PairFree lacks, and the items settled as blocked or not applicable. status: open (known, not built), built, blocked (a hard rule or a real impossibility), not-applicable (the app has no such control). A blocked or not-applicable item lists `evidence`: searches over files of the vendor app outside the repo (`root`, `glob` on file names, `pattern`) that must find nothing (`expect: none`, the default) or something (`expect: some`); the gate runs them again at every release, so a claim that the app's own files refute fails there. Add an item as soon as a post or an audit shows a gap; set it to built in the change that builds it. An open item in a brand that a release touches refuses the release unless the owner waived it in data/release_waivers.json (owner, 2026-11-21, after the Sennheiser Momentum 5 equalizer and the 1MORE Q30 two-device switch shipped missing).

items.what: Asked for as the second-generation equalizer (UserEQ_GetConfiguration) and shown when the Momentum 5 and Momentum True Wireless 5 answer, without presets (branch fix/sennheiser-momentum5).
The 0 to 100 transparency slider (ANC_Transparency, answered in the report) for the Momentum 5 (branch fix/sennheiser-momentum5).
The two-device switch for EH902, ES903, EC305, HC905, HC306, EF906, S51 and S70, as Life's Lab page shows it (branch fix/1more-lab-features).

Life 5.0.3's Lab features page read in full (ExperimentActivity): two devices (done), the wake word for EH902 and ES903 (already on) and sleep monitoring for ES603 (already on); the pairing popup is the app's own setting.
Spatial audio and the connection mode on the Home tab (branch fix/1more-lab-features).
A four-tap gesture and a hold action per earbud: Life 5.0.3's strings offer only double and triple tap (operation_double_click, operation_triple_click) and no setting for the hold.

A reported defect: after the earbuds reset to the standard connection mode the app keeps showing the last choice (issue #58); find why the shown state is not the read one, and offer to set the mode again on connecting.
The earbuds list the service 00000000-deca-fade-deca-deafdecacaff and no standard serial port; PairFree only tries the standard serial channel.
Crusher technology's dial and profiles are Bragi's, not Airoha RACE commands: no race command class names them.
Clear Voice smart mic is a feature guide screen with no control: the app's API layer never names it.
Mimi's personal sound needs Mimi's server sign-in (hard rule: no server authentication).

Life's home page (fragment/d.java, 53 model predicates) and its other screens show or hide controls by model (ah.* predicates); the audit of those gates against PairFree's per-model flags is not done beyond the Lab page.

Whether these answer UserEQ_GetConfiguration as the second-generation equalizer or have the parametric one (stage filters, PEQEqualizer2): needs a device report from this version or the command numbers traced in the Plus app (docs/sennheiser/PROTOCOL.md 4.1).
